facts.activity_file: testing for dead and applying earths

control_failures.control_label: application of positive isolation devices and personal locks
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - engineering change note not applied to TX-3002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on TX-3002 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. TX-3002 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 1 February 2008 a planned spot check of TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks not effective.
